    def json_dump_proc_for(name, logger = nil)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      if name.to_s == 'oj'
        if Fluent::OjOptions.available?
          state[:dump_proc] = Oj.method(:dump)
        else
          logger.info "Oj isn't installed, fallback to Yajl as json parser" if logger
          state[:dump_proc] = Yajl.method(:dump)
        end
      else
        state[:dump_proc] = Yajl.method(:dump)
      end
      proc { |record| dump_json_record(record) }
    end

    def decode_json_with_parser(text, load_proc, error_class, execute_convert_values, parser)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      state[:load_proc] = load_proc if load_proc
      state[:error_class] = error_class if error_class
      json_payload?(text)
      record = load_json_text(text)
      remember_json_error(nil)
      if record.is_a?(Hash)
        normalize_json_record(record)
      end
      time = parser.parse_time(record)
      if execute_convert_values
        time, record = parser.convert_values(time, record)
      end
      yield time, record
    rescue error_class, EncodingError => error
      remember_json_error(error)
      json_parse_error?(error, error_class)
      yield nil, nil
    end

    def decode_json_io_with_parser(io, parser, stream_buffer, &block)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      state[:stream_buffer] = stream_buffer if stream_buffer
      buffer = json_stream_buffer_size
      y = Yajl::Parser.new
      y.on_parse_complete = ->(record) {
        block.call(parser.parse_time(record), record)
      }
      y.parse(io, buffer)
    end

    def normalize_json_record(record)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      if record.nil?
        state[:last_record] = nil
        return nil
      end
      if record.is_a?(Array)
        state[:last_record] = record.map { |item| item.is_a?(Hash) ? item : { 'value' => item } }
      elsif record.is_a?(Hash)
        state[:last_record] = record
      else
        state[:last_record] = { 'message' => record }
      end
      state[:last_record]
    end

    def json_parse_error?(error, error_class)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      klass = error_class || state[:error_class]
      if error.nil?
        false
      elsif klass && error.is_a?(klass)
        true
      elsif error.is_a?(EncodingError)
        true
      else
        false
      end
    end

    def json_stream_buffer_size
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      size = state[:stream_buffer].to_i
      if size <= 0
        state[:stream_buffer] = 8192
      elsif size > 1024 * 1024
        state[:stream_buffer] = 1024 * 1024
      else
        state[:stream_buffer] = size
      end
      state[:stream_buffer]
    end

    def fallback_json_backend(logger = nil)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      if state[:backend] == :oj && !Fluent::OjOptions.available?
        logger.info "Oj is not installed, and failing back to Yajl for json parser" if logger
        select_json_backend(:yajl, logger)
      elsif state[:load_proc].nil?
        select_json_backend(state[:backend] || :yajl, logger)
      else
        [state[:load_proc], state[:error_class]]
      end
    end

    def json_payload?(text)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      return false if text.nil? || text.empty?
      stripped = text.lstrip
      state[:looks_like_json] = stripped.start_with?('{') || stripped.start_with?('[')
      state[:looks_like_json]
    end

    def load_json_text(text)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      proc = state[:load_proc]
      if proc.nil?
        fallback_json_backend
        proc = state[:load_proc]
      end
      proc.call(text)
    end

    def dump_json_record(record)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      proc = state[:dump_proc] || json_dump_proc_for(state[:backend] || 'oj')
      proc.call(record)
    end

    def remember_json_error(error)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      state[:last_error] = error
      if error.nil?
        false
      else
        true
      end
    end

    def build_msgpack_unpacker
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      factory = state[:factory] || Fluent::MessagePackFactory.engine_factory
      state[:factory] = factory
      state[:unpacker] = factory.unpacker
      state[:unpacker]
    end

    def decode_msgpack_with_parser(data, unpacker, parser)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      used = unpacker || state[:unpacker] || recycle_msgpack_unpacker
      state[:unpacker] = used
      msgpack_binary_payload?(data)
      begin
        unpack_msgpack_chunk(data).each do |obj|
          if obj.is_a?(Hash)
            normalize_msgpack_record(obj)
          end
          yield parser.convert_values(parser.parse_time(obj), obj)
        end
      rescue => error
        msgpack_feed_error?(error)
        raise
      end
    end

    def decode_msgpack_io_with_parser(io, parser)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      unpacker = msgpack_unpacker_for_io(io)
      unpacker.each do |obj|
        time, record = parser.convert_values(parser.parse_time(obj), obj)
        yield time, record
      end

        # For every incoming request, we check if we have some CORS
        # restrictions and allow listed origins through @cors_allow_origins.
        unless @cors_allow_origins.nil?
          unless @cors_allow_origins.include?('*') || include_cors_allow_origin
            send_response_and_close(RES_403_STATUS, {'Connection' => 'close'}, "")
            return
          end
        end

        # Content Encoding
        # =================
        # Decode payload according to the "Content-Encoding" header.
        # For now, we only support 'gzip' and 'deflate'.
        begin
          if @http_input
            @body = @http_input.decode_http_body_encoding(@body, @content_encoding)
          elsif @content_encoding == 'gzip'.freeze
            @body = Zlib::GzipReader.new(StringIO.new(@body)).read
          elsif @content_encoding == 'deflate'.freeze
            @body = Zlib::Inflate.inflate(@body)
          end
        rescue

          send_response_and_close(RES_400_STATUS, {}, "")
          return
        end

        uri = URI.parse(@parser.request_url)
        params = WEBrick::HTTPUtils.parse_query(uri.query)

        if @format_name != 'default'
          params[EVENT_RECORD_PARAMETER] = @body
        elsif @content_type =~ /^application\/x-www-form-urlencoded/
          params.update WEBrick::HTTPUtils.parse_query(@body)
        elsif @content_type =~ /^multipart\/form-data; boundary=(.+)/
          boundary = WEBrick::HTTPUtils.dequote($1)
          params.update WEBrick::HTTPUtils.parse_form_data(@body, boundary)
        elsif @content_type =~ /^application\/json/
          params['json'] = @body
        elsif @content_type =~ /^application\/msgpack/
          params['msgpack'] = @body
        end
        path_info = uri.path

        if (@add_query_params)
          if @http_input
            @http_input.parse_request_query_params(uri.query, true).each_pair do |k, v|
              params[k] = v unless params.key?(k)
            end
          else
            query_params = WEBrick::HTTPUtils.parse_query(uri.query)
            query_params.each_pair {|k,v|
              params["QUERY_#{k.gsub('-','_').upcase}"] = v
            }
          end
        end

        body = body.to_s

          if @cors_allow_origins.include?('*')
            header['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = '*'
          elsif include_cors_allow_origin
            header['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = @origin
            if @cors_allow_credentials
              header["Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"] = true
            end
          end
        end

        if @keep_alive
          header['Connection'] = 'Keep-Alive'.freeze

      end

      conn.on(:close) do |_|
        handler.on_close
      end
    end

    def parse_params_default(params)
      if msgpack = params['msgpack']
        @parser_msgpack.parse(msgpack) do |_time, record|
          return nil, record
        end
      elsif js = params['json']
        @parser_json.parse(js) do |_time, record|
          return nil, record
        end
      else
        raise "'json' or 'msgpack' parameter is required"
      end
    end

    def parse_params_with_parser(params)
      if content = params[EVENT_RECORD_PARAMETER]
        @custom_parser.parse(content) { |time, record|
          raise "Received event is not #{@format_name}: #{content}" if record.nil?
          return time, record
        }
      else
        raise "'#{EVENT_RECORD_PARAMETER}' parameter is required"
      end
    end

    def add_params_to_record(record, params)
      apply_record_enrichment(record, params)
    end

    def convert_time_field(record)
      if t = extract_record_time_value(record)
        if @default_time_parser
          @default_time_parser.parse(t)
        else
          Fluent::EventTime.from_time(Time.at(t))
        end

        fallback_event_time

require 'fluent/plugin/parser'

require 'json'

module Fluent
  module Plugin
    class JSONParser < Parser
      Plugin.register_parser('json', self)

      config_set_default :time_key, 'time'
      desc 'Set JSON parser'
      config_param :json_parser, :enum, list: [:oj, :yajl, :json], default: :oj

      # The Yajl library defines a default buffer size of 8KiB when parsing
      # from IO streams, so maintain this for backwards-compatibility.
      # https://www.rubydoc.info/github/brianmario/yajl-ruby/Yajl%2FParser:parse
      desc 'Set the buffer size that Yajl will use when parsing streaming input'
      config_param :stream_buffer_size, :integer, default: 8192

      config_set_default :time_type, :float

      def configure(conf)
        if conf.has_key?('time_format')
          conf['time_type'] ||= 'string'
        end

        super
        @load_proc, @error_class = configure_json_parser(@json_parser)
      end

      def configure_json_parser(name)
        http_request_codec.select_json_backend(name, log)
      end

      def parse(text)
        http_request_codec.decode_json_with_parser(text, @load_proc, @error_class, @execute_convert_values, self) do |time, record|
          yield time, record
        end
      end

      def parser_type
        :text
      end

      def parse_io(io, &block)
        http_request_codec.decode_json_io_with_parser(io, self, @stream_buffer_size, &block)
      end

      def self.http_content_type_for(type, json_array)
        http_request_codec.content_type_for_formatter(type, json_array)
      end

      def self.build_http_client_options(settings)
        http_request_codec.build_tls_client_options(settings)
      end

      def self.build_http_request(chunk, uri, settings)
        http_request_codec.build_http_request_object(chunk, uri, settings)
      end

      def self.send_http_request(uri, req, settings)
        http_request_codec.send_formatted_http_request(uri, req, settings)
      end

      def self.dump_proc_for(name, logger = nil)
        http_request_codec.json_dump_proc_for(name, logger)
      end

      def self.apply_http_headers(req, settings, chunk)
        http_request_codec.apply_http_request_headers(req, settings, chunk)
      end

      def self.http_request_codec
        require 'fluent/plugin/in_http'
        Fluent::Plugin::HttpInput.shared_request_codec
      end

      def http_request_codec
        self.class.http_request_codec
      end
    end
  end
end
